'''Crossing Lanes Station''' was an upscale [[Space station/Legends|resupply depot]]<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was known for its wealthy clientele who could pay for discreet business. In [[45 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] stopped at the space station to refuel the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' and meet [[Luewet Wuul]].<ref name="Crucible" />
